headline: Almost 29 billion hryvnias in taxes collected in Vinnytsia region since the beginning of the year - 20 minutes
summary: Taxpayers in Ukraine's Vinnytsia region paid 28.7 billion hryvnias to budgets of all levels in the first seven months of 2026. Receipts rose by almost 5 billion hryvnias year on year.
why: Regional tax receipts indicate the strength of local economic activity and the funding available for public spending in Ukraine.
